name: cycle
source:
TYPE a
 b AS b
END TYPE
TYPE b
 a AS a
END TYPE
DIM p AS a

name: unknown_type
source: DIM p AS missing

END DEFine

name: subarray_argument
source:
TYPE a
 values(2)
END TYPE
DIM items(2) AS a
edit items(1)
DEFine PROCedure edit(dest AS a)
END DEFine
error: Cannot pass a record array element

name: record_array_copy
source:
TYPE a
 x
END TYPE
DIM p(2) AS a, q(2) AS a
p = q
error: Copy destination must be one record

name: unknown_field
source:
TYPE a
 x
END TYPE
DIM p AS a
p.typo = 1

name: unsafe_arguments
source:
TYPE p
 x
 y
END TYPE
DIM values(2) AS p
consume advance%(), values(i%)
DEFine PROCedure consume(n%,dest AS p)
END DEFine
DEFine FuNction advance%
 RETurn 1
END DEFine

name: unsafe_expression_selector
source:
TYPE p
 x
 y
END TYPE
DIM values(2) AS p
PRINT magnitude(values(next%()))
DEFine FuNction magnitude(v AS p)
 RETurn v.x
END DEFine
DEFine FuNction next%
 RETurn 1
END DEFine

source:

 x

REFERENCE x%
DEFine PROCedure edit(VAL x%)
END DEFine
